claims.text: The public BESCOM home exposes JVS Fast Track Services with New Connection and Track New Connection links, a separate EODB New Connection label, a normal Other Services New Connection link, and a public Help label calling 1912.
claims.notes: Observed on 2026-08-30 without login or case data.

claims.text: The public JVS eligibility page states that JVS covers LT1 Domestic and LT3 commercial tariff loads up to 18KW excluding 18KW for new single or multiple connections and exposes the exact controls `I have read and agree to the Terms and Conditions for Account Registration*`, `OK`, and `Cancel`.
claims.notes: Checkbox/OK only opened the blank form; no case eligibility was decided.

claims.text: The public JVS eligibility page lists as not eligible: premises attracting line extension or electrical-network modification; buildings over 15 metres and over 500 sqmt total plinth area; premises requiring an Occupancy Certificate; buildings attracting Clause 9 Conditions of Power Supply; unauthorised, revenue or abandoned layouts; HT category; and incomplete wiring, meter board or service-main cable.
claims.notes: Published list only; no property-specific determination.

claims.text: The public JVS form exposes eight tabs: `Application type`, `Provide Temporary Account Id`, `Personal Details`, `Power Supply Required at (AD.)`, `Correspondence Address`, `Location Details`, `Miscellaneous Details`, and `Document Upload`; the initial panel exposes `Single` and `Multiple Connection`.
claims.notes: Blank form only; Single was selected to reveal the next stage.

claims.text: The blank JVS form exposes Temporary Account Id with `Get Details` and `Skip`; Personal Details with Business/Personal, Applicant Name*, Gender (Select/Male/Female/Others), Email ID*, Joint, Phone Type* (Select/Mobile/LandLine), Phone Number*, ID Type* (Driving License Number/PAN/PASSPORT/TAN/UID/Aadhar Number/Voter’s ID), ID Number*, check-icon and Save & Continue; address/correspondence with address line 1*, address line 2, City*, disabled State Karnataka, disabled Country India, Pincode*, and Copy Address Same As Above; Location Details with Latitude*, Longitude*, Area of Site (Sqft)*, Stilt Floor Available* (Select/Yes/No), Total No of Floors (Including Stilt floor)*, Total built up area(m²)* and Save & Continue.
claims.notes: No account, personal, contact, identity, address, location or building value was entered.

claims.text: The blank JVS Miscellaneous Details stage exposes Power Supply required for* (Select/Domestic-LT1/Commercial-LT3/EVC-Station-LT6C), Postpaid/Prepaid radios with Postpaid initially checked, Premise Location* (BBMP/BDA/Rural Local Body or Village or Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body or CMC or TMC), Sub Division Office*, Section Office*, Nature of Business*, Required Load* from 240W through 17.5KW, Required Phase* (Single Phase/Three Phase), AEH / Non AEH Phase, Required Voltage* (230 V/440 V), Type Of Power* (Motive/Lighting/Light & Heat) and Save & Continue.
claims.notes: Visible options are not a case-specific allowable-load decision.

claims.text: The blank JVS Document Upload stage shows `Upload Documents - Please upload any one of the document for mandatory (*) category`, accepted extensions `.JPEG, .JPG, .BMP, .TIF, .TIFF, .JPE, .JFIF, .PDF, .GIF`, `Max Total Upload Size : 4 MB`, DigiLocker file and Document Status columns, Choose File for Identity Proof*, Proof of Ownership*, Geo-Tagged building photo* and Completion Certificate, a Get Aadhaar from Digilocker link, and a final Submit.
claims.notes: No chooser, DigiLocker action or Submit was activated.

claims.text: The JVS document table labels Identity Proof* with `Photo copy of PAN Card/Driving License/Passport/Aadhar Card/Voter ID*`, Proof of Ownership* with `Photo copy of the Sales deed, Khata certificate, Tax paid certificate.`, Geo-Tagged building photo* with `Upload full building photo along with LAT LONG`, and Completion Certificate with `Completion-cum test report along with wiring diagram`.
claims.notes: Labels were read without selecting a document.

claims.text: The public normal New Connection form exposes ten tabs: Application type, Temporary / Permanent, Personal Details, Power Supply Required at (AD.), Correspondence Address, Miscellaneous Details, Location Details, LEC Details, Miscellaneous Details 2 and Document Upload; its application panel exposes LT, HT/EHT and MC/MSB, while Temporary / Permanent initially checks Permanent and exposes Temporary Account Id, Get Details and Skip.
claims.notes: No application type, personal data, account identifier, upload, payment or submission was used.

claims.text: BESCOM's public FAQ says the normal New Connection route is under Other Services, needs no customer login for direct application, and covers LT, HT/EHT and MC/MSB; it describes personal/address, miscellaneous/load, optional LEC details, confirmation and charge-breakdown stages.
claims.notes: FAQ route description is not a case eligibility or completion decision.

claims.text: BESCOM's public FAQ says that for normal new connection only the application fee can be paid online and remaining additional charges need to be paid by visiting the SDO office.
claims.notes: No fee, charge, demand, payment or receipt was generated.

claims.text: The public JVS eligibility page says that if an application is rejected for non-compliance with eligibility criteria or requested Load, Tariff or Name modification, registration and GST are excepted, MSD/AISD deposits and SLC/ASLC non-revenue charges are refunded, and all other charges are forfeited; it separately says that where an applicant does not desire power supply and has not executed the agreement, amounts are refunded after deducting 10% of the total amount under Clause 4.03 Note of KERC.
claims.notes: Published wording only; no rejection or refund was observed.

claims.text: BESCOM's public FAQ says that if money is debited but payment acknowledgement is not generated, the user should not pay again for the same bill, should wait 24 hours for Bill Desk to confirm with the bank and update payment, and may contact Bill Desk at `@billdesk.com` or `080-25586664`; the FAQ also says online-payment doubts may be directed to Customer Care `1912`.
claims.notes: Published recovery text; no payment was attempted.

claims.text: BESCOM's public home displays power supply within 24 hours after requisite-fee payment for domestic LT-1 and commercial LT-3 consumers with total load <=17.5 KW and no line extension, and an EODB New Connection label for stated Bengaluru LT 50–150 KW and HT 25–200 KVA applications within 7 days without RoW or 15 days with RoW; the FAQ separately displays `3 working days (24 hours) after registration and payment made.` for FTNC.
claims.notes: Displayed conditional labels with differing wording; no case clock or supply outcome.

claims.text: The public BESCOM New Connection Tracker exposes `Request ID*`, an `OR` separator, `Account ID*` and a `Submit` button.
claims.notes: No identifier was entered and Submit was not activated.

claims.text: The unauthenticated pass does not establish whether login, OTP, CAPTCHA, field-level validation, application acknowledgement, demand generation, payment result, document rejection, tracker result, inspection, meter installation or supply completion follows any public control.
claims.notes: Pass stopped before identifiers, personal data, files, payment and Submit. Unknown is a research boundary, not evidence of absence.
